description: In a bright art restoration studio a young woman in a white lab coat and purple gloves, with a magnifying visor on her head and a pencil in her hair bun, dabs an old dark oil painting on an easel with a small cotton pad. As she wipes, bright blue sky and then a figure in a red robe appear under the brown dirt. She gasps, steps back and smiles with delight. A tray of cotton swabs, jars and a colour chart lie on the table, and other restorers work behind.

to rest on a wooden easel
